definitions.supplemental: a from, syndrian to sunder, part
definitions.meaning: To put ASUNDER, to separate, disjoin, sever

quotations.old_english: Ic com mann asyndrian ongén his fæder
quotations.latin: veni separare hominem adversus patrem suum

quotations.old_english: Se deáþ asyndreþ líc and sáwle

source_text: a-syndran, -syndrian; íc asyndrige; p. ede, ode; pp. ed, od [a from, syndrian to sunder, part] To put ASUNDER, to separate, disjoin, sever; separare :-- Ic com mann asyndrian ongén his fæder veni separare hominem adversus patrem suum, Mt. Bos. 10, 35: Ps. Spl. 67, 10. Se deáþ asyndreþ líc and sáwle death sunders body and soul, Soul Kmbl. 7 ; Seel. 4. v. a-sundrian.
